'''Carosi VI''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Carosus system]]. Originally the sixth orbit in the system, it became the first following the expansion of the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Carosi]] into a [[Red giant/Legends|red giant]] and the subsequent destruction of system's first five planets. Prior to the expansion, it was considered to be a world suitable for [[Terraforming/Legends|terraforming]], but Carosi's expansions burned away any life-sustaining potential.
